issue.title: Spotify episodes become first-class podcast references
issue.description: Every Spotify episode link given to `bob ref create`, capture, or Keep becomes one deduplicated `podcasts` reference. Its PDF is an episode dossier: cover, show, date, duration, clickable chapters, full show notes, and a highlightable transcript when the publisher's own feed proves the match. Every other Spotify link is refused, or is kept as an ordinary item, with a hint that says what to do instead. No Spotify link reaches the article engine again.

API for later phases: metadata::fetch_episode(&SpotifyEpisode, scratch, progress, prefetched_page: Option<&Path>) -> Result<EpisodeMetadata, EpisodeError>; EpisodeMetadata{id, canonical_url, title, show, show_uri, publisher, released{instant,precision}, duration_ms, language, cover_url, notes_html, notes_text, sources: BTreeMap<EpisodeField, MetadataSource>, warnings} with published_date() in Bob's day zone and source_of(); MetadataSource::{as_str() = spotify_page|spotify_embed|spotify_oembed, label() = 'spotify page'…}; EpisodeError::{NotFound(404), HttpStatus, Fetch, NoMetadata} with message()/hint()/retryable()/status()/render(). payload.entry: API for transcript_dossier (os.9): podcast/feed.rs find_feed_item(&EpisodeMetadata, PodcastEnrich, scratch, deadline: Instant, progress) -> FeedOutcome {Matched(FeedItem), NoFeed(reason), NoMatch(reason; ties start "ambiguous:"), DeadlineExceeded, Off}. Off makes no request; DeadlineExceeded maps to "feed lookup stopped after 45 s". FeedItem: feed_url/feed_host (post-redirect), guid, title, pub_date, duration_secs (drift guard), notes_html (content:encoded else description, invisibles stripped), transcripts [{url,mime,language,rel}], chapters Option<FeedChaptersLink{url,mime}>, matched_on + matched_on_label() ("title, date" for the dry-run line). fetch_feed_chapters(&link, scratch, deadline, progress) -> ChaptersOutcome {Chapters(Vec<notes::Chapter>), Ignored(reason), DeadlineExceeded}; parse_chapters_json is pure. fetch.rs gained fetch_url_before(url, dest, max_time, max_bytes, deadline, progress) + deadline_spent(deadline) — use them for the 10 MiB transcript download so one 45 s budget covers feed + transcript. Config: HighlightsConfig::podcast_enrich() parses highlights.podcasts.enrich auto|off (default auto); its docs (configuration.md + highlights-create.md) are still owed by transcript_dossier per the plan. Test seam: podcast::test_support::FakeSpotify now has serve_url(exact URL) and an itunes surface.

podcast/feed.rs: iTunes Search -> up to 3 ranked public RSS feeds (25 MiB/30 s capped, roxmltree with DTDs refused) -> unique item agreeing on 2 of title/date(36 h)/duration(max 5 s, 2 %); fails open with NoFeed/NoMatch/DeadlineExceeded/Off. Podcasting 2.0 chapters JSON fetch+parse; highlights.podcasts.enrich auto|off in config/mod.rs; deadline-aware fetch_url_before in fetch.rs. Real trimmed Pragmatic Engineer iTunes result + feed fixtures (matches episode 4UgVFWty2I8hGAgSvT7pjC on all three signals). 23 feed tests cover 0/1/several candidates, 404-then-second feed, ranking, tie, DAI drift, over-cap, malformed XML, DTD refusal, private feed URL, enrich off (no requests in fake curl log), spent deadline. just check: fmt + clippy clean; cargo test --workspace 12450 passed, 0 failed.
